description.value: Westview Centre Motel is a recently refurbished 20-room hillside motel on Marine Avenue in Powell River, with panoramic views of Malaspina and Georgia Straits and the Salish Sea. It sits half a block from the ferry terminal serving Comox and Texada Island, and is walking distance from Willingdon Beach and the trailhead network that connects to the 180-km Sunshine Coast Trail. The motel proactively arranges discounted cycling and kayak rentals from local businesses for guests who book direct.

address.value: 4534 Marine Ave, Powell River, BC V8A 2K4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the motel is active and recently refurbished. Free Wi-Fi is explicitly stated in room descriptions; nearby grocery (Safeway, Walmart) and evening food (restaurants across the road) are confirmed via the Family Room page and guest reviews. No mention of secure bike storage or a defined staff bike procedure appears anywhere on the site, though the motel actively promotes cycling in Powell River and arranges cycling-rental discounts for direct bookings.
concerns: Secure overnight bike storage is not mentioned anywhere on the website; direct follow-up with the motel is needed to confirm this required WWC criterion.
OSM address field omits the city and postal code ('4534 Marine Avenue'); website provides full address '4534 Marine Ave, Powell River, BC V8A 2K4'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, recently refurbished motel in a premier BC cycling destination (Powell River / Sunshine Coast Trail), cycling-aware, near ferry connections, and clearly relevant to touring cyclists. Secure bike storage is unconfirmed and should be verified before final listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The motel explicitly promotes cycling in Powell River (Things To Do page) and offers guests discounted cycling-rental referrals through direct booking. It is also noted as motorcycle-friendly and pet-friendly. All rooms have kitchenettes, which reduces the importance of a packed breakfast for self-sufficient touring cyclists.

Nearby evening food.detail: Booking.com review quoted on site: 'many restaurants just across the road'; Family Room page notes popular local restaurants near Willingdon Beach steps away

Nearby grocery.detail: Family Room page lists Safeway and Walmart as a 2-minute drive from the motel
